exposure: Timing of maternal HIV diagnosis during pregnancy
outcome: Perinatal HIV transmission to the baby
cohort: The study included 51 pregnant women living with HIV/AIDS who were pregnant at any time between April 2015 and July 2017.
finding: Out of 51 mothers, four babies were diagnosed with HIV, and all these four babies were delivered by mothers who were diagnosed with HIV in or after the second trimester of pregnancy.
